high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white photograph depicting the construction of the Golden Gate Bridge, with a focus on the installation of a safety net. The text overlay at the top provides historical context about the decision to install the safety net. Text Overlay: The text reads: "When building the Golden Gate Bridge, a lead structural engineer Joseph insisted on the installation of a safety net even though its $130,000 cost was deemed exorbitant.
